description: Abstract generic class for iterating and inspecting elements within a PDF content stream, providing methods to move to next/previous elements of type T with various filtering options.

classes.name: ObjectGetterBase<T>
classes.description: Abstract class facilitating iteration over content stream elements of type T, with methods for moving to specific elements based on position, type, and custom checks.

methods.name: MoveAndGet
methods.description: Core method to move within the content stream to find the next or previous element satisfying certain conditions, with support for counting only matching elements.

methods.name: MoveAndGetNext
methods.description: Moves forward to the next element of type T, optionally skipping neighbors.

methods.name: MoveAndGetPrevious
methods.description: Moves backward to the previous element of type T, optionally skipping neighbors.

methods.name: MoveAndGetNext (overload)
methods.description: Moves forward a specified number of steps to find an element of type T.

methods.name: MoveAndGetPrevious (overload)
methods.description: Moves backward a specified number of steps to find an element of type T.

methods.name: MoveAndGetNext (with check)
methods.description: Moves forward to the next element satisfying a custom check.

methods.name: MoveAndGetPrevious (with check)
methods.description: Moves backward to the previous element satisfying a custom check.
